title: Scissors congruences, II
container-title: Journal of Pure and Applied Algebra
note: J. Pure Appl. Algebra 25(2) (1982), 159-195. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1016/0022-4049(82)90035-4) (2026-11-28). Establishes the pre-Bloch group P(C) modulo the 5-term relation, the Steinberg wedge homomorphism z wedge (1 - z) -> Lambda^2 C^*, and the Bloch-Wigner dilogarithm regulator on hyperbolic 3-polytopes.
